title: Dasakam 43 — Tṛṇāvartavadha
description: Yashoda sets down the heavy infant; Trinavarta carries Krishna in a whirlwind, Gokula searches through dust, the child is found unharmed, and the closing stanza prays for complete relief from illness.

source.commentary: intake/D043/photo-captions.txt; original source metadata preserved in content/sources/d043/source.json

translation_note: No sourced English verse translation is present in the supplied D043 source bundle; translation_en is intentionally empty pending editorial review.

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वामेकदा गुरुमरुत्पुरनाथ वोढुं
गाढाधिरूढगरिमाणमपारयन्ती ।
माता निधाय शयने किमिदं बतेति
ध्यायन्त्यचेष्टत गृहेषु निविष्टशङ्का ॥ ४३-१ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvāmekadā gurumarutpuranātha voḍhuṃ
gāḍhādhirūḍhagarimāṇamapārayantī |
mātā nidhāya śayane kimidaṃ bateti
dhyāyantyaceṣṭata gṛheṣu niviṣṭaśaṅkā || 43-1 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Yashodha felt baby Krishna was too heavy to carry and left him on the bed. She was worried of the baby and kept praying to Bhagwan  constantly while attending to her household chores.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावद्विदूरमुपकर्णितघोरघोष-
-व्याजृम्भिपांसुपटलीपरिपूरिताशः ।
वात्यावपुः स किल दैत्यवरस्तृणाव-
-र्ताख्यो जहार जनमानसहारिणं त्वाम् ॥ ४३-२ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvadvidūramupakarṇitaghoraghoṣa-
-vyājṛmbhipāṃsupaṭalīparipūritāśaḥ |
vātyāvapuḥ sa kila daityavarastṛṇāva-
-rtākhyo jahāra janamānasahāriṇaṃ tvām || 43-2 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Then there heard a terrific sound raising dust all through the atmosphere. Demon Trinavarta came in the form of whirl wind and carried Krishna, the one who carries away the mind of people, amidst the envelope of dust and started rising upward.

stanzas.sanskrit:
उद्दामपांसुतिमिराहृतदृष्टिपाते
द्रष्टुं किमप्यकुशले पशुपाललोके ।
हा बालकस्य किमिति त्वदुपान्तमाप्ता
माता भवन्तमविलोक्य भृशं रुरोद ॥ ४३-३ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
uddāmapāṃsutimirāhṛtadṛṣṭipāte
draṣṭuṃ kimapyakuśale paśupālaloke |
hā bālakasya kimiti tvadupāntamāptā
mātā bhavantamavilokya bhṛśaṃ ruroda || 43-3 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The dust caused darkness in the entire Gokulam. Gopas and gopikas lost clear vision and mother Yashoda searched for her baby in that darkness. Not finding Krishna, she cried loudly.

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावत् स दानववरोऽपि च दीनमूर्ति-
-र्भावत्कभारपरिधारणलूनवेगः ।
सङ्कोचमाप तदनु क्षतपांसुघोषे
घोषे व्यतायत भवज्जननीनिनादः ॥ ४३-४ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvat sa dānavavaro’pi ca dīnamūrti-
-rbhāvatkabhāraparidhāraṇalūnavegaḥ |
saṅkocamāpa tadanu kṣatapāṃsughoṣe
ghoṣe vyatāyata bhavajjananīninādaḥ || 43-4 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Meanwhile Trinavarta found baby's body becoming more heavier for him to carry and reduced his speed, his body shrank in size and noise of whirling wind also subsided.  Soon the whole Gokulam was echoing the cries of Yashoda.

stanzas.sanskrit:
रोदोपकर्णनवशादुपगम्य गेहं
क्रन्दत्सु नन्दमुखगोपकुलेषु दीनः ।
त्वां दानवस्त्वखिलमुक्तिकरं मुमुक्षु-
-स्त्वय्यप्रमुञ्चति पपात वियत्प्रदेशात् ॥ ४३-५ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
rodopakarṇanavaśādupagamya gehaṃ
krandatsu nandamukhagopakuleṣu dīnaḥ |
tvāṃ dānavastvakhilamuktikaraṃ mumukṣu-
-stvayyapramuñcati papāta viyatpradeśāt || 43-5 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Nandagopan and other Gopas, Gopikas quickly reached the house and everyone cried in grief. In exhaustion, Trinavartha wanted to release Bhagwan, who actually releases everyone from bondages.

stanzas.sanskrit:
रोदाकुलास्तदनु गोपगणा बहिष्ठ-
-पाषाणपृष्ठभुवि देहमतिस्थविष्ठम् ।
प्रैक्षन्त हन्त निपतन्तममुष्यवक्ष-
-स्यक्षीणमेव च भवन्तमलं हसन्तम् ॥ ४३-६ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
rodākulāstadanu gopagaṇā bahiṣṭha-
-pāṣāṇapṛṣṭhabhuvi dehamatisthaviṣṭham |
praikṣanta hanta nipatantamamuṣyavakṣa-
-syakṣīṇameva ca bhavantamalaṃ hasantam || 43-6 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: The Gopikas were exhausted by their crying and wailing. Then outside the house, they saw a huge and heavy body falling on the rock. What a wonder! On the chest of the dead body, they found baby Krishna.

stanzas.sanskrit:
ग्रावप्रपातपरिपिष्टगरिष्ठदेह-
-भ्रष्टासुदुष्टदनुजोपरि धृष्टहासम् ।
आघ्नानमम्बुजकरेण भवन्तमेत्य
गोपाः दधुर्गिरिवरादिव नीलरत्नम् ॥ ४३-७ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
grāvaprapātaparipiṣṭagariṣṭhadeha-
-bhraṣṭāsuduṣṭadanujopari dhṛṣṭahāsam |
āghnānamambujakareṇa bhavantametya
gopā dadhurgirivarādiva nīlaratnam || 43-7 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Gopas were amazed to see Krishna playing smilingly, with his lotus like hands on the chest of dead body of Trinavartha, without a single bruise. The Gopas picked up Krishna as if they picked up the blue gem from a big mountain.

stanzas.sanskrit:
एकैकमाशु परिगृह्य निकामनन्द-
-न्नन्दादिगोपपरिरब्धविचुम्बिताङ्गम् ।
आदातुकामपरिशङ्कितगोपनारी-
-हस्ताम्बुजप्रपतितं प्रणुमो भवन्तम् ॥ ४३-८ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ekaikamāśu parigṛhya nikāmananda-
-nnandādigopaparirabdhavicumbitāṅgam |
ādātukāmapariśaṅkitagopanārī-
-hastāmbujaprapatitaṃ praṇumo bhavantam || 43-8 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Nandagopan and Gopas rushed and took the child in arms, embraced and kissed with great joy. Gopikas also wanted to embrace baby Krishna. Krishna, like the honey beetle, jumped in to the lotus like hands of the Gopikas.

stanzas.sanskrit:
भूयोऽपि किन्नु कृणुमः प्रणतार्तिहारी
गोविन्द एव परिपालयतात् सुतं नः ।
इत्यादि मातरपितृप्रमुखैस्तदानीं
सम्प्रार्थितस्त्वदवनाय विभो त्वमेव ॥ ४३-९ ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
bhūyo’pi kinnu kṛṇumaḥ praṇatārtihārī
govinda eva paripālayatāt sutaṃ naḥ |
ityādi mātarapitṛpramukhaistadānīṃ
samprārthitastvadavanāya vibho tvameva || 43-9 ||
stanzas.commentary_en: Nandagopan and Yashoda wondered how to avoid such incidents in future and hence prayed to Govinda to protect their son, actually they prayed to Bhagwan himself for his own welfare.

stanzas.sanskrit:
वातात्मकं दनुजमेवमयि प्रधून्वन्
वातोद्भवान् मम गदान् किमु नो धुनोषि ।
किं वा करोमि पुनरप्यनिलालयेश
निश्शेषरोगशमनं मुहुरर्थये त्वाम् ॥ ४३-१० ॥
stanzas.stanza_roman:
vātātmakaṃ danujamevamayi pradhūnvan
vātodbhavān mama gadān kimu no dhunoṣi |
kiṃ vā karomi punarapyanilālayeśa
niśśeṣarogaśamanaṃ muhurarthaye tvām || 43-10 ||
stanzas.commentary_en:
Thus Bhagwan killed the Asura who was in the form of the wind. 
Bhattathri requests Bhagwan  to eradicate all his internal and external ailments.
